name: customizable-navigation-website
description: 高度自定义的导航网站

scripts.preview: wrangler pages dev public --cwd nav-main --kv=nav --d1=DB --compatibility-date=2024-05-28 --compatibility-flag nodejs_compat
scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/baseline/*.test.mjs tests/phase0/*.test.mjs tests/phase1/*.test.mjs tests/phase2/*.test.mjs tests/phase3/*.test.mjs tests/phase4/*.test.mjs tests/phase5/*.test.mjs tests/phase6/*.test.mjs tests/unit/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:phase4: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/phase4/*.test.mjs tests/unit/sanitize.test.mjs && playwright test tests/e2e/smoke.spec.ts tests/e2e/search.spec.ts tests/e2e/admin.spec.ts
scripts.test:phase5: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/phase5/*.test.mjs && playwright test tests/e2e/visual.spec.ts tests/e2e/responsive.spec.ts
